subject.title: [Feature]: Option to force-prepend an opening <think> tag for local reasoning models

question: Should OpenClaw support undelimited reasoning from local completion backends through a public model compatibility contract, or require those backends to provide structured reasoning output?
rationale: This changes the public configuration surface and determines whether ambiguous model-output normalization belongs in shared core or provider-owned transport code, which requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Require structured reasoning
options.body: Keep shared core canonical and document Responses API or provider-adapter normalization as the supported path for reasoning models.

options.title: Add compatibility metadata
options.body: Introduce a default-off provider/model compatibility field and normalize exactly once before shared reasoning partitioning.

options.title: Add the requested agent flag
options.body: Expose a global and per-model prepend option despite the ambiguity of treating initial assistant text as reasoning.

recommendation.title: Require structured reasoning
recommendation.body: Keep shared core canonical and document Responses API or provider-adapter normalization as the supported path for reasoning models.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared reasoning-stream implementation and the existing issue discussion provide the strongest ownership signal for this boundary decision.
